name: HeadLenss
description: Voice-driven Claude Code controller. G2 mic -> Speechmatics -> headlenss server (tmux send-keys).
author: takashicompany

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Provide current location to plugins opened through HeadLenss (e.g. walking guides). Location is not stored or sent to the headlenss server.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Capture voice input from G2 glasses microphone

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Talk to Speechmatics ASR and the headlenss server
